description: Land Acquisition - Beragala, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for a public project (construction of a water storage tank). It contains a formal notice under the Land Acquisition Act, describes the specific land to be acquired (including location, lot number, and extent), and provides details about compensation claims and inquiries. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, property interests, and compensation matters related to real estate.
